<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.90</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.90">Released</a> on June 01, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[DevOps] Playground: Configure Nginx for Docker Deployment @0xt3j4s (#7748)</li>
  <li>Fix no-useful test case @Aisuko (#7751)</li>
  <li>added service for playground using metallb @anshuhtwt (#7583)</li>
  <li>[Server] Platform detect func improvement @Azanul (#7722)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Remove no useful test cases and add new testcase @Aisuko (#7767)</li>
  <li>feat: Add test cases for closest_arg @Aisuko (#7760)</li>
  <li>feat: Add two test cases for meshery auth @Aisuko (#7759)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>add endpoint to download the application/designs with particular :id @harkiratsm (#7692)</li>
  <li>[bug] Fix user prefs API for google tag manager @theBeginner86 (#7758)</li>
  <li>Fixing the key spacing error again for the updated UI  @0xt3j4s (#7755)</li>
  <li>Fixing the key-spacing error (in app.js file) occurring on ‘RUN ESLint Meshery-UI’ @0xt3j4s (#7749)</li>
  <li>Fix eslint typeof warning @8rxn (#7688)</li>
  <li>move dark mode under preferences menu @sudhanshutech (#7726)</li>
  <li>feat: add Beta badge on meshmap title @Udit-takkar (#7728)</li>
  <li>[Feature] - Search Functionality for MeshModel Browser and a Tab for Displaying Relationships @UsmanDev09 (#7736)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[bug] Fix user prefs API for google tag manager @theBeginner86 (#7758)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>feat: Add test cases for closest_arg @Aisuko (#7760)</li>
  <li>Add Meshery Extensions Issue_Template @8rxn (#7745)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>meshsync update documented @Azanul (#7721)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@0xt3j4s, @8rxn, @Abhishek-kumar09, @Aisuko, @Azanul, @Chadha93, @Udit-takkar, @UsmanDev09, @anshuhtwt, @harkiratsm, @l5io, @leecalcote, @muhammmadusman3211, @sudhanshutech, @theBeginner86 and l5io</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.91</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.91">Released</a> on June 09, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Added status to connection @abdullah1308 (#7814)</li>
  <li>[Performance] Fix NightHawk load generator @MUzairS15 (#7832)</li>
  <li>[events] Track SystemID @theBeginner86 (#7802)</li>
  <li>[Performance] Nighthawk: Upgrade to v0.7.0 @leecalcote (#7826)</li>
  <li>Remove core model reference from the relationship json @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7822)</li>
  <li>fix golang-ci lint test @ayushthe1 (#7810)</li>
  <li>Add Paper component to storybook @senali-d (#7809)</li>
  <li>[playground] Update docker based deployment @theBeginner86 (#7757)</li>
  <li>[Devops] Updated the nginx.conf @kunal-gg (#7747)</li>
  <li>fix: check if the pattern upload, is valid @harkiratsm (#7784)</li>
  <li>Add PITS Global Data Recovery Services in the list of adopters @ghost (#7785)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Update filter usage in docs @alphaX86 (#7824)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Fix Preflight Check for Remote Endpoints  @PiyushRaj927 (#7737)</li>
  <li>feat: make test cases in for utils more simple and effectively @Aisuko (#7783)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Fix ESOCKETTIMEDOUT intermittent CI run cypress settings and user pref integration tests failures @MarioArriaga92 (#7829)</li>
  <li>Bump @storybook/addon-styling from 0.3.2 to 1.0.8 in /ui @dependabot (#7772)</li>
  <li>Bump @babel/eslint-parser from 7.19.1 to 7.21.8 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7771)</li>
  <li>[bug] Fix Dereferencing bug @theBeginner86 (#7819)</li>
  <li>Bump @emotion/react from 11.10.8 to 11.11.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7774)</li>
  <li>Bump @cypress/code-coverage from 3.10.0 to 3.10.7 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7777)</li>
  <li>Meshery Management Page: Fixes Dark Mode Dialog Bug @ciradu2204 (#7707)</li>
  <li>Removing one extra closing bracket from the README.md @yuvrajrathva (#7786)</li>
  <li>Bump @emotion/styled from 11.10.6 to 11.11.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7778)</li>
  <li>Bump start-server-and-test from 1.15.3 to 2.0.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7779)</li>
  <li>Bump @emotion/styled from 11.10.5 to 11.11.0 in /ui @dependabot (#7782)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[bug] Fix Dereferencing bug @theBeginner86 (#7819)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump @storybook/addon-styling from 0.3.2 to 1.0.8 in /ui @dependabot (#7772)</li>
  <li>Bump @babel/eslint-parser from 7.19.1 to 7.21.8 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7771)</li>
  <li>[CI] Add golangci.yml for ignore file @Aisuko (#7820)</li>
  <li>Update cncf-playground-reset.yaml @Revolyssup (#7813)</li>
  <li>Update meshmodel issue template @leecalcote (#7812)</li>
  <li>Fix failing cluster cleanup workflow @Revolyssup (#7799)</li>
  <li>[MeshModel] add references to Meshmodel template @MUzairS15 (#7811)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/onsi/gomega from 1.23.0 to 1.27.7 @dependabot (#7781)</li>
  <li>Bump @emotion/react from 11.10.8 to 11.11.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7774)</li>
  <li>Bump @cypress/code-coverage from 3.10.0 to 3.10.7 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7777)</li>
  <li>Bump @emotion/styled from 11.10.6 to 11.11.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7778)</li>
  <li>Bump start-server-and-test from 1.15.3 to 2.0.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7779)</li>
  <li>Bump @emotion/styled from 11.10.5 to 11.11.0 in /ui @dependabot (#7782)</li>
  <li>feat: make test cases in for utils more simple and effectively @Aisuko (#7783)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Update filter usage in docs @alphaX86 (#7824)</li>
  <li>Playground page @goldfishdolphin (#7763)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Broaden description of managed infra @jamieplu (#7798)</li>
  <li>Connections crud @Azanul (#7581)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Aisuko, @Azanul, @Chadha93, @MUzairS15, @MarioArriaga92, @PiyushRaj927, @Revolyssup, @abdullah1308, @alphaX86, @ayushthe1, @ciradu2204, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @goldfishdolphin, @harkiratsm, @jamieplu, @kunal-gg, @l5io, @leecalcote, @meshery[bot], @nebula-aac, @senali-d, @theBeginner86, @yuvrajrathva, MUzairS15, l5io and pheianox</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.92</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.92">Released</a> on June 13, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[performance] Final changes for nighthawk @MUzairS15 (#7847)</li>
  <li>[Performance] fix nighthawk @MUzairS15 (#7846)</li>
  <li>[chore] Update API for auto archive meshery server @theBeginner86 (#7719)</li>
  <li>[chore] Error codes cleanup @nebula-aac (#7789)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Add golden files back, because they are required by the other pakcages’ test cases @Aisuko (#7834)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Performance] Fix issues with Performance profiles @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7830)</li>
  <li>[Catalog] Support Unpublish Catalog Content @theBeginner86 (#7753)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[bug] Remove False check for ValidPatternfile @theBeginner86 (#7835)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[chore] Update APIs @theBeginner86 (#7844)</li>
  <li>trigger workflow run on Pull request @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7841)</li>
  <li>change permission to test the action yaml @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7840)</li>
  <li>[Snapshot] test on pull_request target @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7839)</li>
  <li>[Snapshot Action] Update MeshMap Snapshot github action @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7833)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/prometheus/common from 0.42.0 to 0.44.0 @dependabot (#7780)</li>
  <li>[playground] Adding workflow to Update K8s Cleanup Script @suhail34 (#7825)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Catalog] Support Unpublish Catalog Content @theBeginner86 (#7753)</li>
  <li>[chore] Update APIs @theBeginner86 (#7844)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Aisuko, @MUzairS15, @Revolyssup, @dependabot, @leecalcote, @nebula-aac, @suhail34, @theBeginner86 and MUzairS15</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.93</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.93">Released</a> on June 13, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[Docker Extension] Contributor instructions @leecalcote (#7837)</li>
  <li>[Server] Enhance Kubernetes missing context error message @leecalcote (#7852)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump relay-runtime from 14.1.0 to 15.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#7773)</li>
  <li>[Performance] revert the subscription delete change @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7853)</li>
  <li>fix settings page title is not updating @Meyazhagan (#7793)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump relay-runtime from 14.1.0 to 15.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#7773)</li>
  <li>Update cncf-playground-deploy-meshery.yaml @leecalcote (#7854)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Meyazhagan, @dependabot and @leecalcote</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.6.95</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.95">Released</a> on June 15, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[performance] add support for labels @MUzairS15 (#7870)</li>
  <li>policies: Fix the detection of the relationship in existing policy @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7864)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Mesheryctl] Support tailing logs in Kubernetes platform @Meyazhagan (#7801)</li>
  <li>Change adapter API callback argument for mesheryctl check @alphaX86 (#7862)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Catalog] make all the fields required in the RJSF form while submitting the catalog request @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7868)</li>
  <li>[UI] - disable deploy and undeploy @UsmanDev09 (#7858)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump github.com/jarcoal/httpmock from 1.2.0 to 1.3.0 @dependabot (#7776)</li>
  <li>[CI] Only release when called by stable release workflow @leecalcote (#7855)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>updated architecture page @thisiskaransgit (#7842)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @MUzairS15, @Meyazhagan, @Revolyssup, @UsmanDev09, @alphaX86, @dependabot, @leecalcote, @thisiskaransgit and MUzairS15</p>
 

   <br/>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.98</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.98">Released</a> on June 23, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Add config attribute to meshery filter @MUzairS15 (#7910)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[UI]: style fix of few components in dark theme @samyakshah3008 (#7907)</li>
  <li>Bump @rjsf/material-ui from 5.8.1 to 5.8.2 in /ui @dependabot (#7906)</li>
  <li>Refactor/dashboard Remove Connection Status Section @aabidsofi19 (#7881)</li>
  <li>Extentions/GitHub/meshmap :  Add GitHub Action for MeshMap Snapshot  @aabidsofi19 (#7888)</li>
  <li>Fix bug in flipcard for filters @sudhanshutech (#7911)</li>
  <li>upgrade rjsf -&gt; 5.8.1 @harkiratsm (#7901)</li>
  <li>[UI]: Fix responsiveness of profile card for mobile view @samyakshah3008 (#7895)</li>
  <li>[UI] RJSF Fixes styles for “name” and “namespace” input fields  <em>labels</em> @Chadha93 (#7889)</li>
  <li>refactor: replaced CreateTable with CreateSelect @vaibhav135 (#7884)</li>
  <li>[UI] Fixes Notification Center Sneak Peak Behavior onClick  @Chadha93 (#7886)</li>
  <li>Database summary - Add table size/record count to System Reset screen @Meyazhagan (#7686)</li>
  <li>fix: remove mapping navigator @Udit-takkar (#7806)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix Cytoscape-to-design conversion process @MUzairS15 (#7922)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Fix bug in flipcard for filters @sudhanshutech (#7911)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Update build-and-release-edge.yml @theBeginner86 (#7927)</li>
  <li>[CI] Update build-and-release-edge.yml @theBeginner86 (#7926)</li>
  <li>[CI] Update build-and-release-edge.yml @theBeginner86 (#7925)</li>
  <li>Bump @rjsf/material-ui from 5.8.1 to 5.8.2 in /ui @dependabot (#7906)</li>
  <li>[CI] Support Edge Releases with Remote Provider @theBeginner86 (#7913)</li>
  <li>Update <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">MeshMap-Snapshot</code> workflow to <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">v0.0.5</code> @MUzairS15 (#7899)</li>
  <li>fix: remove mapping navigator @Udit-takkar (#7806)</li>
  <li>[Update Dockerfile] Add comment for future reference @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7876)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Adding Catalog page in docs @yash37158 (#7732)</li>
  <li>[CI] GraphQL: Docs Build Target @leecalcote (#7924)</li>
  <li>Server.go file missing #7887 @vaibhav-xt (#7902)</li>
  <li>fixed: meshery-docs hover tabs and focus on sidebar option @vaibhav135 (#7831)</li>
  <li>
    <table>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td>[Docs] Initialize Extension’s user facing documentation</td>
          <td>CU-85zrzt5fg @Chadha93 (#7807)</td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.6.99</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.99">Released</a> on June 28, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[MeshModel] Update relationship schema @MUzairS15 (#7966)</li>
  <li>Added tabs component to storybook @senali-d (#7860)</li>
  <li>[Filters] Change filter file download endpoint @MUzairS15 (#7964)</li>
  <li>[Remote Provider] Support for pagesize and count @abdullah1308 (#7892)</li>
  <li>Update WASMFilter.json @MUzairS15 (#7959)</li>
  <li>[MeshModel] Add WASM Filter component @MUzairS15 (#7955)</li>
  <li>[MeshModel] Add <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">WASM Filter</code> as a core component. @MUzairS15 (#7929)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Resource endpoints audit @abdullah1308 (#7917)</li>
  <li>Parsing the relative path correctly @suhail34 (#7951)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Resource endpoints audit @abdullah1308 (#7917)</li>
  <li>Bump relay-compiler from 14.1.0 to 15.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#7945)</li>
  <li>Fix dropdown input border color in dark mode @HarshDobariya79 (#7923)</li>
  <li>Bump @cypress/code-coverage from 3.10.1 to 3.10.7 in /ui @dependabot (#7935)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 12.9.0 to 12.15.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7941)</li>
  <li>Bump @emotion/server from 11.10.0 to 11.11.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7936)</li>
  <li>Bump webpack-cli from 5.0.1 to 5.1.4 in /ui @dependabot (#7937)</li>
  <li>Bump next from 13.3.4 to 13.4.7 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7938)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-plugin-cypress from 2.13.2 to 2.13.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7944)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint from 8.39.0 to 8.43.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7934)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump relay-compiler from 14.1.0 to 15.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#7945)</li>
  <li>Bump @cypress/code-coverage from 3.10.1 to 3.10.7 in /ui @dependabot (#7935)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 12.9.0 to 12.15.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7941)</li>
  <li>Updated redocly workflow to update swagger files @abdullah1308 (#7957)</li>
  <li>Bump @emotion/server from 11.10.0 to 11.11.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7936)</li>
  <li>Bump webpack-cli from 5.0.1 to 5.1.4 in /ui @dependabot (#7937)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/spf13/viper from 1.15.0 to 1.16.0 @dependabot (#7940)</li>
  <li>Bump next from 13.3.4 to 13.4.7 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7938)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-plugin-cypress from 2.13.2 to 2.13.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7944)</li>
  <li>Bump golang.org/x/oauth2 from 0.0.0-20221014153046-6fdb5e3db783 to 0.9.0 in /scripts/component_generation @dependabot (#7947)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint from 8.39.0 to 8.43.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7934)</li>
  <li>Bump google.golang.org/api from 0.103.0 to 0.128.0 in /scripts/component_generation @dependabot (#7948)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshkit from 0.6.37 to 0.6.46 in /scripts/component_generation @dependabot (#7949)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshkit from 0.6.38 to 0.6.46 in /scripts/component_updation @dependabot (#7946)</li>
  <li>Change ruby version and Adapter Documentation @Boombag0607 (#7933)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Resource endpoints audit @abdullah1308 (#7917)</li>
  <li>Change ruby version and Adapter Documentation @Boombag0607 (#7933)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.7.0-beta-1</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.0-beta-1">Released</a> on December 04, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[Meshmodel] Fix Shapes @aabidsofi19 (#9558)</li>
  <li>chore: move gcp model to ‘provisioning’ @leecalcote (#9556)</li>
  <li>[Server] [Models] feat: annotation filter support in models endpoint @leecalcote (#9549)</li>
  <li>chore: recategorize shape models @leecalcote (#9550)</li>
  <li>[Models] AWS and GCP: Model realignment; Annotations @leecalcote (#9542)</li>
  <li>[Server] Update Policies and relationships @MUzairS15 (#9512)</li>
  <li>fix typo in model name @MUzairS15 (#9509)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-features">🚀 Features</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Dashboard] - Dashboard datattable sorting @senali-d (#9514)</li>
  <li>[UI] Added avatar in design card @Yashsharma1911 (#9369)</li>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

    (() => {
      window.addEventListener("load", function () {
        let scrollElem = document.getElementsByClassName("sidebar-nav__section-link active").item(0);
        if (scrollElem) {
         scrollElem.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "nearest", inline: "start" });
        }
        let activeSections = document.querySelectorAll(".sidebar-nav__section-link.active");
      activeSections.forEach(function (activeSection) {
        let parentCollapse = activeSection.closest(".collapse");
        if (parentCollapse) {
          parentCollapse.classList.add("show");
        }
      });
    });

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.0-beta-2">Released</a> on December 04, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[policies] Improve support for policies evaluation. @MUzairS15 (#9517)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Add missing Watch-List configuration on Meshery Helm Chart CRD @KiptoonKipkurui (#9562)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@KiptoonKipkurui, @MUzairS15, @leecalcote and @sudhanshutech</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.7.0</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.0">Released</a> on December 08, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>fix gcp icons @aabidsofi19 (#9605)</li>
  <li>[Meshmodel] Update Annotations and add capabities @aabidsofi19 (#9603)</li>
  <li>[Relationships] Update relationships definitions to include <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">RoleBinding to Service Account</code> mapping. @MUzairS15 (#9601)</li>
  <li>add capabilities to flow chart shapes @aabidsofi19 (#9596)</li>
  <li>chore: relocate and rename conn and cred @leecalcote (#9559)</li>
  <li>[Model] Flowchart Shapes: Document, MultipleDocuments, Process, StoredData @leecalcote (#9563)</li>
  <li>[server][meshsync] hard reset database @VihasMakwana (#9545)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[UI] Fix K8s formatter for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">meshery controller</code> statuses. @MUzairS15 (#9597)</li>
  <li>Fix Issue #9590 in component “DashboardComponent” in UI. @Dananjay996 (#9594)</li>
  <li>Bump @babel/types from 7.23.0 to 7.23.5 in /ui @dependabot (#9528)</li>
  <li>[Fixes - Documentation] update the CONTRIBUTING.md with Issues &amp; Pull Requests sections @sandramsc (#9579)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 13.4.0 to 13.6.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#9591)</li>
  <li>[UI] Dashboard: Styling for details view in grids @leecalcote (#9593)</li>
  <li>[UI] Dashboard enhancement  @theBeginner86 (#9589)</li>
  <li>fix: fix bug where node name is empty @VihasMakwana (#9511)</li>
  <li>[UI] Fixes eslint warnings/errors in Provider UI @Pushkarm029 (#9576)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump github.com/prometheus/client_golang from 1.16.0 to 1.17.0 @dependabot (#9534)</li>
  <li>Bump @babel/types from 7.23.0 to 7.23.5 in /ui @dependabot (#9528)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 13.4.0 to 13.6.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#9591)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Added about uninstalling meshery using a Docker Extension platform @Srishtihere (#8638)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Add code for additional alert types and eliminate duplicate entries @coder12git (#9225)</li>
  <li>Updated creating-a-meshery-design.md @nwanduka (#9507)</li>
  <li>Add setup instructions for using WSL2 on contributing UI page w/signoff  @gyancodes (#9585)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Dananjay996, @MUzairS15, @Pushkarm029, @Srishtihere, @VihasMakwana, @aabidsofi19, @coder12git, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @gyancodes, @leecalcote, @nwanduka, @sandramsc and @theBeginner86</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.7.1</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.1">Released</a> on December 11, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Bump axios from 0.26.1 to 1.6.0 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#9340)</li>
  <li>[chore] upgrade to meshkit v0.7.0 @MUzairS15 (#9606)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[feat] add enhancements, fix latency while searching models @VihasMakwana (#9573)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[UI] Changed User.js from class based component to functional component @Mohith234 (#8918)</li>
  <li>[feat] add enhancements, fix latency while searching models @VihasMakwana (#9573)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[server][fix]: don’t exit in case of context is persisted @VihasMakwana (#9608)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@MUzairS15, @Mohith234, @VihasMakwana, @Yashsharma1911, @aabidsofi19, @dependabot and @leecalcote</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {
  var url = "https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=meshery/meshery";

  }).then(function(e) {

  }).then(function(r) {
     console.log(r.items[0])

     forks = r.items[0]['forks_count']
     $('#stars').text(stars + " Stars")
     $('#forks').text(forks + " Forks")
  });

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.7.10</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.10">Released</a> on January 10, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>chore(deps): Bump follow-redirects from 1.15.3 to 1.15.4 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#9909)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Bug] - Fix workspace and environment required field validation @senali-d (#9917)</li>
  <li>chore(deps): Bump follow-redirects from 1.15.2 to 1.15.4 in /ui @dependabot (#9903)</li>
  <li>[UI] Fix CASL issues @Yashsharma1911 (#9904)</li>
  <li>chore(deps): Bump follow-redirects from 1.15.2 to 1.15.4 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#9905)</li>
  <li>[Enhancement] - Workspace and environments @senali-d (#9890)</li>
  <li>fix tooltip styling @sudhanshutech (#9906)</li>
  <li>resolved label cutoff issue @Aniket-76 (#9900)</li>
  <li>[fix] Some ui fixes in env and workspaces @sudhanshutech (#9896)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>chore(deps): Bump follow-redirects from 1.15.2 to 1.15.4 in /ui @dependabot (#9903)</li>
  <li>chore(deps): Bump follow-redirects from 1.15.2 to 1.15.4 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#9905)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] Sitemap with URLs @leecalcote (#9908)</li>
  <li>feat: build a provider @leecalcote (#9889)</li>
  <li>[Docs] New Suggested Reading layout @leecalcote (#9891)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Aniket-76, @Yashsharma1911, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @leecalcote, @senali-d and @sudhanshutech</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.7.101</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.7.101">Released</a> on September 16, 2024</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Provider interface @MUzairS15 (#12043)</li>
  <li>initialize usercapabilities persister @MUzairS15 (#12031)</li>
  <li>[Models] New model: meshery-dev-icons @leecalcote (#11984)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="️-meshery-cli">⌨️ Meshery CLI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Add version flag support on model export command @lekaf974 (#11934)</li>
  <li>Update model.go @vishalvivekm (#11986)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-meshery-ui">🖥 Meshery UI</h2>

<ul>
  <li>migrate theming to user prefs @aabidsofi19 (#12039)</li>
  <li>configure meshery ui before building @codeSafari10 (#12035)</li>
  <li>fix right align issue of radio group rjsf model @amitamrutiya (#12022)</li>
  <li>chore: remove unused @codeSafari10 (#12034)</li>
  <li>Enhance permissions flow @codeSafari10 (#12029)</li>
  <li>Fix not showing seeded designs in local provider @Yashsharma1911 (#12030)</li>
  <li>[CI] Update e2e test result comment formatting with Skipped indicator @102vansh (#12017)</li>
  <li>fix: e2e test result comment formatting with Skipped indicator @yash37158 (#12014)</li>
  <li>chore: disable failing test @jerensl (#11971)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>configure meshery ui before building @codeSafari10 (#12035)</li>
  <li>Anonymous user @Jougan-0 (#11980)</li>
  <li>Fix generate keys workflow @dragon-slayer875 (#12020)</li>
  <li>chore: make keys workflow a cron job @dragon-slayer875 (#12018)</li>
  <li>[CI] Bump Snapshot Action to v0.2.11 @leecalcote (#12007)</li>
  <li>chore: fix the versioning on snapshot @jerensl (#11985)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>create a empty folder entitled week-of-09-23-2024 w/signoff @JianMinTang (#12027)</li>
